title: Investigate the Unauthorized Access Attempt
description: Identify the IAM user responsible for the unauthorized access attempt.
recommended_next_focus: Correlate the IAM user with other security signals and determine the scope of the threat.

title: Review CloudTrail Logs
description: Analyze CloudTrail logs for additional evidence of the unauthorized access attempt.
recommended_next_focus: Look for patterns or anomalies in the IAM user's activity.

title: Check Billing Activity
description: Verify if there are any unexpected charges associated with the IAM user.
recommended_next_focus: Confirm if the unauthorized access attempt resulted in financial loss.
